blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution panel is confident that it could finish the presentation of evidence against Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth by October. This was according to lead prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro after she cited the scheduled whole-day trial proceedings next month.
